notes.title: Revisiting the Art and Design of Asterigos: Curse of the Stars
notes.content:
Greetings, brave warriors of the Northwind Legion!

We are excited to participate in this year’s ‘Art of Indies’ showcase. As it follows from the event's name, today, we’d like to revisit some of the artwork and designs we created when developing Asterigos: Curse of the Stars.

Level and movement design
In Asterigos: Curse of the Stars, you explore the complex City of Aphes, featuring numerous unique districts inhabited by various vile creatures. It was essential to us to make your city exploration seamless and exciting. That's why we've approached the level design with extra attention.

https://i.imgur.com/I1mpfSS.png
Сlick to enlarge.

In the early design phase, we brainstormed many possibilities for how our character could move through the level. How fast should she be, can she dash or not, what kind of obstacles will there be and which of them can be interactable? It's a fun yet not-so-easy process.

The best way to determine all of this is to test how it feels in-game, including flips through the walls, climbing, sliding, or wading through water. Even jumping was a hot topic within the team! Here are a couple of sketches we did during our brainstorming. 

https://i.imgur.com/BVZ4uOb.png
Click to enlarge.
The world of Asterigos is full of dangers, so you must tread carefully. Or not.

https://i.imgur.com/BgWJ211.png
Click to enlarge.
Examples of different mechanisms, blockages and other obstacles and the ways to interact with them.

The creation of Hilda from concept to Hero
When you first enter the City of Aphes, you’ll quickly realise that you’re an outsider. Everything Hilda identifies with, from her clothes to weapons, differs from the sophisticated technology and society of Aphes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/01029553f9aa50b7ffcb4eb70bed7fc27b131255.jpg

Originally, Hilda was going to be a blonde-haired protagonist. In the end, to emphasize the contrast between herself and the people of Aphes, Hilda’s hair was made red, and her wardrobe inspired by Celtic designs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/fabfaba701332f9f98b1c0de2986484ddaea7a27.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/19f47aaf347c181a31df3f31dda356d3b898a5cb.jpg

Hilda has gone through several phases of transformation to become the red-haired warrior you see today in Asterigos: Curse of the Stars. 

If you’re a cosplay aficionado, you can check out our official Hilda Cosplay Guide here to recreate her iconic look.

Designing the enemies
When we decided to draw inspiration from the culture and history of ancient Rome and classical Greece, we delved into the myths and legends of both periods.

There are many fabled and epic creatures in folklore that we wanted to add to the game. However, it was extremely important to us that these creatures fit into our story and were truly part of the world and not just copied from other settings. We wanted players to see familiar-looking monsters when they encountered them while at the same time providing a unique experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/5fd2d3ee08db6f0fc73dbba5513f1738c486c75a.png

Each creature is placed into a common background of the 'cult' they belong to. From this, the art team formed the art style of the creatures that fit with the scenes and other characters. Our artists have added magical runes and tattoos to cultists' bodies so that these characters better fit the overall image of the faction they represent and the narrative.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/0548597b3993c8ce42513b19dc1c1932eee4677f.png

[hr][/hr]
We love the world we created, from brainstorming to story writing, concepts, modelling, texturing, adding animations and VFX, and eventually AI and skill designing. Each of these elements cultivates the hard work of many artists and departments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/5a506b87bb12a16c2e383de7ef4442a5891bc645.png

We hope that you enjoyed exploring the world of Asterigos: Curse of the Stars as much as we enjoyed designing it!

notes.title: The adventurer’s guide to accessing new content in the Call of the Paragons DLC
notes.content:
We understand that some players are having difficulties finding portals to Phantasma. So today, we are sharing a few tips on accessing the new content in the DLC and what you need to do to open the coveted portals. 

How to access Phantasma?
Phantasma is a dangerous realm accessible only to the most experienced warriors. Therefore you must first unlock and obtain a few things during the main story progression and complete the game to activate the portals leading to the Paragon trials.

Teleportation
First, you need to unlock the ability to teleport between conduits. Simply play through the main story, complete Phalan Academy, Arges Bazaar and Stella Mine investigations and return to Minerva in the Shelter. 

Tool Bags
You must also find two tool bags and return them to Vulcane in the Shelter. 
Doing this will unlock her future ability to craft special weapons for you. Look for these bags in Arges Bazaar and Stella Mine.

After completing these steps and finishing the main storyline, the mysterious shrines you came across whilst exploring the city will become active.

https://i.imgur.com/m1SdC51.gif

Upgrade your weapons
Don’t forget that Vulcane can enhance your weapons with powerful modifications. Simply talk to her in the Shelter, select ‘Mods’, choose the desired weapon, and gather enough Essence of the Paragons from Phantasma to make it happen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/3b5551146c609a80794c70f0c8939602ee80136e.jpg

Paragon Trials - Locations

The following part will contain spoilers, so if you don’t want to know the shrine locations and want to explore the world yourself, please do not read further. 

[hr][/hr]
[spoiler]In total, seven shrines lead to the Paragon Trials. Here’s how and where you can find them.

Black Streets
Boss: Alkinoos
‘The trials shrine in Black Streets can be found inside the building next to the Saintess.’

 Teleport to Inner City Rampant and exit towards the bridge in the Ghetto.
 You’ll find the Trials shrine in the building to the left after you cross the bridge.
https://i.imgur.com/ormENni.jpg

Arges Bazaar
Boss: Hippocrates
‘The trials shrine in Arges Bazaar can be found inside the building with the refugees after receiving the Ice Enchantite from the Priest of the Three.’

 Teleport to Guardian Shrine.
 Trials shrine can be found right next to the conduit.
https://i.imgur.com/NotexOQ.jpg

Phalan Academy
Boss: Phillipos
‘The trials shrine at Phalan Academy is inside the guarded building in the area where you first met with Otto’

 Teleport to Political Campus and walk back and down the stairs.
 Trials shrine is inside the building with a blue tree on it.
https://i.imgur.com/26PA3gC.jpg

Sunken Outskirts
Boss: Caeso
‘The trials shrine in Sunken Outskirts is located inside the building where one of the maiden keys is found, just outside of the hunters' camp.’

 Teleport to Hunter's Camp and walk out of the area through the metal gates towards Ponte's Legacy
 Trials shrine is inside the building with a blue tree on top.
https://i.imgur.com/1p6pHc1.jpg

Arges Plaza
Boss: Euthenia
‘The trials shrine in Arges Plaza can be found inside the building close to Prima Boulevard, right after you pass the armoured bull.’

 Teleport to Prima Boulevard and walk through the pillars towards the building (defeat or run past the armoured bull to reach the Trials shrine).
 Trials shrine is inside the building with a blue tree on it.
https://i.imgur.com/lp5Cb3D.jpg

Glittering Deeps
Boss: Eureus
‘The trials shrine in Glittering Deeps can be found in the building located in the Underground Lake.’

 Teleport to Underground Lake, go down the path from the conduit and then keep going left until you see the building
https://i.imgur.com/rWaVtuw.jpg

Caelum Summit
Boss: The Arbiter
This trial unlocks only after completing the other six.
‘The trials shrine in Caelum Summit can be found underground, in the building in the Disc of Smite area.’

 Teleport to Trail of Astrology, take the path towards the waterfall and walk straight forward. Climb down (don't jump, you will die) and continue walking on the path. After crossing the bridge, take a right, go down the stairs and then enter the structure on the left. When there, take the elevator to go down to the shrine.
 Trials shine is underground.
 You can also find this shrine using an alternative route, but for that, you need to have unlocked the gates towards Disc of Smite. Teleport to the Acropolis and go through the gates. Take the path uphill until you reach the white structure, and then take the elevator down.  
https://i.imgur.com/NYljfGh.jpg
[/spoiler]

We hope you find this guide useful as you search for the ancient portals to Phantasma.

Please share your experiences of the trials with us!

notes.title: Designing the Paragons
notes.content:
With the release of the Asterigos: Call of the Paragons expansion right around the corner, Hilda can step into Phantasma - a mysterious new realm full of danger and untold legends.

In today's devlog, we want to open up the mystery a bit and tell you about Phantasma and the challenges you will have to face.

The breathtaking Phantasma
Phantasma is the realm of the Ascended Paragons, the heroes and heroines of Aphes' past who ascended and rested among the Gods of the Stars. We really wanted the area to resemble and be associated with myths and mystique of cosmic proportions.

Hence the color blue, the purple night sky, and the many interstellar phenomena, as if Hilda had stepped into an alien world where everything simultaneously looks so exotic and yet familiar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/9378e361def6a352974b15bf8169c563723d31a9.jpg

A realm full of stories
When we were designing the world of Asterigos, we had many stories to tell. These include the struggle for the lives of the citizens of Aphes, the bravery of the Northwind Legion, and the story of the City of Stars. However, there are many stories we haven't had time to tell, especially the myths of Aphes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/13816bb74ac4fca1aa68e86d07d9a4008aef928f.jpg

So this time, with Phantasma as the central location for the DLC, we finally get to tell the story and build the adventure around it.

The challenges Hilda will face are those of the Paragons. These legendary heroes rested among the Gods for eons until their sleep was disturbed by an unknown dark force. When Hilda entered Phantasma, the paragons perceived the stranger as an intruder and thought she was the one behind unleashing the dark force.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/e648d237777edc47e1a1ec785ccacee72ee7355d.png

Hilda must prove her innocence by passing the harshest trials of the Paragons, the one of which we are about to tell you.

Facing the Legendary Heroes of the Past
One of the seven heroes Hilda will face is Hippocrates. Founder of the Phalan Academy. The tenth Archon of the Legion. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/e43c39bb9e33e88990886faa99178e1fd3e536a1.png

Despite his noble origins, Hippocrates did not possess the arrogance and haughtiness inherent in other Aristoi. He was rude, impertinent, and unashamedly critical of his opponents. This character helped him get along with his peers in the legion in no time. 

Believing that warriors should be well-trained in combat, magic, and wisdom, Hippocrates quickly put his thoughts into practice after joining the legion. He endowed his shield with Starite magic and controlled the shield's levitation with magic, taking his enemies by surprise during battles. This was unheard of in those days for Aphes, and Hippocrates was the first warrior to use Starite magic in his battle weapons.

Seeking to encourage the use of Starite in weapons, Hippocrates even used his family's wealth and lands to conduct research and eventually developed various types of astral ballistas, which were considered very advanced at the time.

Some could release a continuous astral beam to trap or obstruct enemies' movement, but the beams trajectory could not be altered during use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/000ffd30576c436456de07aa298a15d933d29b59.png

Others could track enemies and destroy them in a matter of seconds, but their range was limited, and they used a much larger amount of Starite.

Due to the limitations of Starite magic technology, the design of astral ballistas was far from perfect, and they were expensive to make. While they could not be made widely available, they were still valuable research material for generations to come.

And though Hippocrates' tenure as the tenth Archon of the Legion was very short, he lived up to his credo and laid the cornerstone for the future of Aphes.

The Trials of Hippocrates
For the Hippocrates challenge, the battle begins with the first phase, an endurance test. Many projectiles like laser beams will be aimed at Hilda, and shields of judgement will fall from the sky, all under the constant onslaught of Hippocrates' minions. Only when Hilda can defeat them can she come face to face with Hippocrates himself.

https://i.imgur.com/r5imZGs.gif

This is how the second phase begins - a strength test. Hippocrates has a floating magical shield that constantly surrounds him and blocks any incoming attacks. This gives him the advantage of being able to push through. And that makes Hippocrates a formidable foe.

https://i.imgur.com/BMb8gSi.gif

Try to figure out the right battle tactics and find his weaknesses!

Upgrade your weapons
We have also introduced a new game system: Weapon Mods. It allows Hilda to further customize her weapons with strong and unique powers. For example, the Brilliant Sun Blades allow Hilda to deal extra damage with her dual blades at the cost of stamina, while the Sword and Shield of the Starry Sky unleash a magic blast with every shield attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/3b5551146c609a80794c70f0c8939602ee80136e.jpg

The new weapon mods can be unlocked by collecting rare materials from Phantasma and across the City of Aphes.

Vulcan will be happy to upgrade the weapons for you in the Shelter!

notes.title: Update 1.06 Preview
notes.content:
Hello, Warriors of the Northwind Legion!

As we mentioned earlier, a new 1.06 update will be released alongside the Call of the Paragons DLC later this month, and today we’d like to give you a preview of what to expect from this update.

The update 1.06 will be free and available to all players who own Asterigos: Curse of the Stars on February 23rd, before the release of the DLC.



Gift of the Nexus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/63283b1fb1c0a6d7d5e31da14446f592ac171bd9.jpg

We wanted to make world exploration even more exciting and rewarding, so in the 1.06 update, a new system called Gift of the Nexus is coming to the game.

You'll be able to find treasure chests scattered throughout the City of Aphes, with various improvements to Hilda's skills, stats, weapons, and more!

notes.title: Community Update and immediate development plans
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Firstly, we want to thank all the brave adventurers who have already made it into the legendary city of Aphes! We are eternally grateful for your support and the feedback you share with us across all channels.
We see and collect a lot of feedback and would now like to tell you about our immediate plans.

Ability to reassign the controls
While the demo was available on Steam, we received a lot of feedback from players regarding the ability to reassign the controls. We actually started working on these customizations before the game's release. We’ll be prioritizing this task so you can re-assign the character controls in the next major update.

We want to ensure that the new keybinding system will be compatible with the current pre-sets and usable for both controller types and mouse + keyboard.

Item interactions
We also received feedback that some players are getting stuck in a status where they cannot interact with the items. We are working to solve this issue to ensure players have a smoother experience.

QoL Improvements
Navigation clarity
We see some places and locations are notably easier to get lost in, so we will be adding more hinting marks to ensure the routes are easier to navigate.

Game performance & combat experience
We will continue to improve the game's overall performance to provide a smoother experience on different configurations. In addition, we plan to improve the combat system further so that players enjoy a more responsive and authentic combat.

Thank you very much for all your feedback! Please keep letting us know about bugs you encounter or suggestions you have in Discord or on the Steam forums.

notes.title: Forging a Hero
notes.content:
May the northern winds protect you on your journey, travellers! 

In our last devlog, we talked about the design of the monsters and the various weapons Hilda has in her arsenal.  

Today, we'll talk about how we created Hilda's persona and some of the other characters you'll meet in the game.

Who is Hilda?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/3c036b4a028d2109f32c4de6b504bb01e7cfb6cb.png

Hilda is an aspiring 18-year-old warrior of the Northwind Legion. She is eager to earn her father’s respect and dreams of joining him on the battlefield. Hilda’s father, Harold, is the commander of the Kingdom of Anbari’s Northwind Legion. Ever since Hilda’s brother fell in battle, Harold has become protective of Hilda and does everything he can to prevent her from taking part in dangerous missions.

But to Harold’s dismay, Hilda is a warrior at heart. One of her goals is to honor her late brother by taking his place in the Northwind Legion. Yet, the more Harold suppresses Hilda’s fighting spirit, the more Hilda tries to prove herself. The relationship between father and daughter has been a bit tense until now, when opportunity blew into the wind. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/c0d3d767faecc9d531db81aaaf3451dea8461835.jpg

Harold and a group of elite soldiers went missing while investigating the magical curse in the City of Aphes. While Hilda is primarily concerned for the safety of her father and fellow soldiers, she knows this is the best opportunity to prove herself to her father. And with that, Hilda’s journey begins.

How legends are made: The creation of Hilda from concept to hero. 

When you first enter the City of Aphes, you’ll realize quickly that you’re a bit of an outsider. From her clothes to her weapons, everything Hilda identifies with is a bit different from the sophisticated technology and society of Aphes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/01029553f9aa50b7ffcb4eb70bed7fc27b131255.jpg

Originally, Hilda was going to be a blonde-haired protagonist. In the end, to emphasize the contrast between herself and the people of Aphes, Hilda’s hair was made red and her wardrobe inspired by Celtic designs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/fabfaba701332f9f98b1c0de2986484ddaea7a27.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/19f47aaf347c181a31df3f31dda356d3b898a5cb.jpg

Hilda has gone through several phases of transformation to become the red-haired warrior you see today in Asterigos: Curse of the Stars.

Clans, Cults, and Communities in Asterigos
Throughout your adventures in Asterigos: Curse of The Stars, you will encounter two different groups - the Aphesians, and the Anbarians, with different factions in each group. 

The Anbarians are the outsiders of the city, who seek fortune and knowledge for their own purpose. The lost Northwind Legion warriors Hilda searches for are also from Anbari.

The Aphesians, of course, are the people of Aphes who have lived in the cursed city for millennia. However, the time has divided the people of Aphes into different groups with conflicting agendas. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/de6dc12168f18c43dc5028b441e31f45ed89a37c.png

You have the Legion of Aphes, who still hold military power in the city; the Ethrus Cult, a group of power-hungry people who seek redemption through the use of dark magic and beast-infusion, and the Adherents, a group of dedicated nobles who seek to find a cure for the curse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/315eb005b85bec5ef37a35a05b8d4865e2d24f3d.png

But in the end, it is Aphesian society that suffers from these warring factions. The long-term impact of the curse has caused Aphes’ society to break down into three major classes: the slaves, the civilians and the Aristoi - the noble class and ruling group of the city-state. They are the most privileged, but also carry the most responsibility for leading society. Yet over time, many of the Aristoi are becoming corrupted and no longer offer the strength and support the city so desperately needs. 

Meanwhile, the Adherents are a group of Aristoi who vows to restore Aphes to its former glory. Thus, they take up the responsibilities to preserve Aphes culture, maintain order, and find a cure to the curse.

And at the center of all of this is Minerva
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/fbc51af452ec80175f1cabe4a1d56395fb8b28f1.png

Minerva has dedicated herself to finding a cure for the curse.  She is noble and elegant, but also full of pride. She has sacrificed so much for her goal. She is going to play a major role in the stories of Asterigos, and we can’t wait for you to meet her and the other fascinating characters we have created for the game.

notes.title: Creatures of Asterigos: Designing the Dire Beasts
notes.content:
Hail, brave warriors!

In our last devlog we briefly touched base on different enemies Hilda will encounter on her journey throughout the legendary City of Aphes. In today’s edition of ‘The Creatures of Asterigos’ we’d like to tell you a bit more about how we designed those dire beasts and their habitat zones.

Monsters of Asterigos: Ethrus, the Dark Cult
The streets of the city are filled with danger around every corner. Each city quarter, including the surrounding areas, is occupied by a host of unique and deadly foes, each with their own special abilities and unique appearance. Let’s talk about one of the enemy factions, The Dark Cult Ethrus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/13af1919ff5e4b5dcff774cffe0c1cbf529056ec.png

These cultists stray from the doctrine of the Gods of Stars, they believe that only an appeal to the wild hearts of the beasts can save them from damnation. To do so, they perform a magical "Ritual of Sublimation" which transforms them into werewolves and other mythical creatures. The ritual allows them to use the powers of the beasts: the strength of bulls, the sharp fangs and claws of wolves or the swift wings of birds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/e1f435ffa79d35d8380e6b469c1cd8e6adca00bd.png

Using Starite – the magical mineral that was used to empower many things in life of Aphesians – some cultists can create powerful spells, such as chain fireballs or even shockwaves. Remember to be extremely careful when traversing the city, cultists often ambush or attack from the blind spots. They also tend to run in groups, making them even more difficult to fight.

Designing the enemies
When we decided to draw inspiration from the culture and history of ancient Rome and classical Greece, we delved into legends and myths. 

There are many mythical and epic creatures in folklore that we wanted to add to the game. It was extremely important to us that these creatures fit into the Asterigos story and that they were truly part of the world and not just copied from other settings. We wanted players to see familiar looking monsters when they encountered them, while at the same time providing a unique experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/11fb7946a07e2332923dabc64392fda612c3dd29.png

Each creature is placed into a common background of the 'cult' they belong to. From this, the art team form the art style of the creatures that fits with the scenes and other characters. Thus, our artists have added magical runes and tattoos to the bodies of cultists so that these characters better fit the overall image of the faction and the narrative. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/45d8859561e046220873340ae9eccc62b079abc8.png

We love the monsters we created. From brainstorming, to story writing, concept drafting, modelling, texturing, adding animations and VFX, and eventually AI and skill designing.  Each of these monsters is the cultivation of hard work of many artists and departments.

We hope that you will enjoy encountering these beasts, as much as we enjoyed designing them.

Adjusting the fight style
Hilda is masterful withwields six weapons: The sword and shield, magic staff, daggers, enchanted bracelets, battle hammer, and spear. She can use any two weapons simultaneously in battle and change them on the go depending on the situation. Each weapon has its respective advantages and disadvantages. For example, when fighting enemies armed with small weapons, using a shield against them will give you an advantage, as it can easily block those attacks.

https://i.imgur.com/7HbeeWq.gif

However, against those wielding a shield or strong armor, a war hammer will be far more effective than a sword, as its powerful blows can easily crush your opponent's defences.

https://i.imgur.com/VbJyELO.gif

You can use any combination of all the weapons available to Hilda to better adapt to the situation on the battlefield. But most importantly, you will be able to create your own combat style by utilizing the unique features and enhancements of the different weapons!

Monsters of the Deeps
During her journey, Hilda will not only explore the surface of the City of Aphes, but also descend into ancient caves full of mystery and peril, where the locals mined the magical mineral Starite. These crystallised minerals shine and emit an illuminating light, like the very stars themselves, hence why the caves are named – Glittering Deeps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/77ffd8ce33b2fcf5d134598a09bc1093c83ccba9.jpg

The history of Glittering Deeps is so ancient that even the modern historical chronicles of Aphes have failed to trace it. There are even ancient ruins in the depths that hint that there was once another, even older city at the site of modern-day Aphes. With so many mysteries around them, the Glittering Deeps is a hazardous place for adventurers.

In the deepest hollow, there is a magical anomaly that causes many cliffs to come to life and behave with hostility to anyone who dares to trespass here. In addition to the stone creatures, there are also 'crystallised monsters' living here. Their appearance blends well with their surroundings and they pose a real danger, lurking among the crystals, stalking their next prey.

One of these terrifying creatures is called Breathless. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/b6e6613156eb3bf575032eeb1d8ad38a7a2ffa68.jpg

Breathless is a fearsome stone creature, possessing a very hard and sturdy body, with the ability to harness the magical power of the tranquilite, of which his body is also partly formed. This monster is capable of striking with his giant stone arms, as well as unleashing a barrage of various projectiles: homing missiles, cannon beams, or exploding rocks.

https://i.imgur.com/meEwmv2.gif

His only weakness is the being’s slow movement and how its every attack takes time to prepare. You would be wise to take advantage of this!

First of all we’d like to say thank you for all the feedback and suggestions you provided us . This has been extremely helpful as we continue to work hard on improving the gaming experience for you.

Now let’s jump into the list of changes we have applied to the demo!

The Controls
We hope to improve the “stiffness” and bring you an overall more enjoyable experience

 We've refined Hilda's actions and controls - she can now switch to sprint/dash state in a timely manner, and all her evasive actions will be properly executed if you have enough stamina points. 
 The stamina points will also now regenerate at a faster rate.
 Hilda can now recover quicker from being knocked down, reducing the uncomfortable feeling during the lost control of the character. 

The Techniques of Weapons
You can now familiarise yourself with the special techniques of each weapon in the weapons interface. We hope this will help you understand the special features of each weapon and what they are useful for!

Input Mapping and Keybinding

notes.title: Building the City of Aphes
notes.content:
Asterigos: Curse of The Stars takes place in and around the majestic city of Aphes. During your journey, you will have to face the myriad of dangers that lurk in the streets and alleys of this legendary ancient city and unravel its mysteries.

Today we would like to tell you more about how we created this majestic architectural marvel.

The city's history
https://i.imgur.com/NX3NMbE.png
Click to enlarge the image

The City of Aphes is the ancient fabled city of stars. Favoured with divine grace of the gods, it sat at the financial and political apex of the entire world… only to crumble in one night due to a single curse. 

For more than a thousand years, many intrepid adventurers and thieves tried their way into Aphes, but none had returned. There were rumours of gigantic man-eaters, terrifying evils, abandoned fortunes, and great, forgotten powers which had yet to be claimed.

Designing the City of Aphes
Since Hilda, the protagonist, comes from a medieval-fantasy world, we wanted to create the best ancient city that matched the spirit of adventure and at the same time had great potential in terms of history, culture and story.

We believe that Ancient Rome and classical Greece are fascinating sources in which we can find both influence and inspiration. Myths, philosophy, systems and history are so rich that the more we delve into them, the more our imagination runs wild with images and ideas.

It has taken some time to put it all together into a coherent image. However, we also wanted to bring something of our own into the mix, so we created magical minerals for the city - Starite. 

https://i.imgur.com/Rnvi48G.png

The Aphesians are adepts of magic using starite. They use it to enhance their lives and create many wonders, including arming their mighty legion. 

To ensure that the visuals matched our imagination, it was important for us to use buildings made of marble, traditional columns, carvings and statues. But on top of that, we wanted to make the world a bit different from what players would expect from a setting like this. That's why colours play another important role and they have to match the aesthetic of the game we wanted to create - a more lively, colourful and an animated look.

In the example below you can see how we created the scene step by step.

https://i.imgur.com/XorrFZG.gif

And so the mysterious and powerful city of Aphes was born, with its architecture and culture inspired by two legendary ancient civilisations and a pinch of magic and wonder.

The surroundings and streets of The City of Aphes
The story begins on the outskirts of the city, in Outerrim. It is a magical forest inhabited by dangerous beasts and monsters. 

https://i.imgur.com/WNAOfwC.png
Click to enlarge the image

Once you enter the town through the aqueduct, which is next to the sealed city gates, you enter Arges Bazaar and the streets where most of the cursed citizens live. But Arges Bazaar has been occupied by a cult that claims to be able to free people from the curse, using even more evil and twisted magic.

https://i.imgur.com/817QpF9.png
Click to enlarge the image

Next to Arges Bazaar is the Phalan Academy, the military base of the Aphes Legion, and Arges Plaza, an area of nobility in Aphes. These places still retain their former glory and grandeur.

https://i.imgur.com/5XZe3Z2.png
Click to enlarge the image

Of course, in addition to the central squares and royal districts, you'll also find slum areas where the poor live, or mines where most of Aphes' magical mineral starites are mined. These areas are controlled by bandits. In addition to that, the city has the Acropolis area, a holy place where temples and shrines are located.

The Shelter
The place Hilda gets to after the first introductory zone is The Shelter. It is the main quest hub of the entire game, and this is where the real adventure begins.

The Shelter is the base of the Adherents, a group of noble Aphesians who have sworn to save the city from the Curse of the Stars. They have been dedicating themselves to this ideal for many hundred years. But never before have they been so close to their goal, as Hilda will play an important role in their campaign, while also carrying out her mission to find her lost father.

https://i.imgur.com/RiPUqT6.png
Click to enlarge the image

Shelter offers Hilda a place where she can return and feel completely safe. Here you can take new quests from the Adherents, make use of the document archives, the vaults, talk to the blacksmiths, visit the shops and even find a sparring partner if you need training! There's plenty to do in the Shelter, and as you progress through the game you'll discover more opportunities.

The Shelter is also a central hub that connects to several major areas of the city. We want players to have a sense of 'universal connection' as they explore it. So it's not a place where you teleport or load in and out, but a place where the real exploration of the city begins.

Dangers around every corner
We think it's important that the enemies match the terrain and the areas they inhabit. We want players to have an immersive experience as they go through their adventure in Aphes.

For example, the cultists of Ethrus and their sublimated followers can only be seen in the streets of Arges Bazaar, as the story has the area abandoned by the Aphes Legion and occupied by cultists. The cultists' minds are perverted by the teachings of their priests, and they prefer to ambush any intruder, hiding in corners when the streets are shrouded in thick fog.

https://i.imgur.com/smVZhsB.png
Click to enlarge the image

The Phalan Academy, on the other hand, is a stronghold of the mighty Aphes Legion, so the military town is guarded by brave soldiers, decurions and trained beasts such as battle lions, led by a centurion. They are well trained, disciplined, loyal, and willing to give their lives to protect the last intact civilians not only from cultists, but also from bandits, monsters, and any strangers.

https://i.imgur.com/SalxUoH.png
Click to enlarge the image

The city of Aphes has many enemies and factions, each with unique abilities and behaviours. Get ready for a wild ride!

[hr][/hr]
When we built the city of Aphes, we wanted it to look like a "real city" that players could immerse themselves in. Therefore, to prevent further spoilers for the game, we just want to remind you to pay more attention to details and explore every corner of Aphes, as you may discover wonders and surprises all around!

https://i.imgur.com/NI9orVt.jpg
Click to enlarge the image

We hope you've enjoyed this little dip into the history of Aphes' creation and we can't wait for you to enter the city!

notes.title: The Creatures of Asterigos: Eulalia the Prayee
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/1da501fddeb250f0de47582e3c1d926a848772ce.png

Forewarned is forearmed! 

In this first instalment of our series of blogs dedicated to the bestiary of Asterigos: Curse of the Stars, we’d like to introduce you to one of the main adversaries that Hilda will have to confront: Eulalia, the Prayee.

Watch the new Trailer
[previewyoutube=SwDNU7JEG9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Know your enemy
Famous for her beautiful voice, Eulalia used to be the most recognized singer during Aphes’ glorious golden age. But, like so many others, she would fall victim to the curse that spread across the city a thousand years ago.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/7edd891af0a07cea9cfbe760d705c1bd9325ca2a.png

The famine brought on by the Asterigos changed her into something else. She turned to an evil cult, the Ethrus, and dedicated herself to it, becoming a symbol by using her reputation and voice to lure more people to join the cult.

https://i.imgur.com/EunmOjR.png

Battle phases
Eulalia uses ranged attacks like voice shock blasts, feather blades, and cyclones. Occasionally she will also descend to the ground to fight Hilda herself using dangerous claw and wing melee strikes.

After some back and forth fights, Eulalia would fly to the sky and use her voice and feather blades to attack Hilda again, and this time, she even calls upon several harpy minions to assist her. During this phase, Hilda must fight the minions while watching out for Eulalia's deadly attacks from above.

https://i.imgur.com/K4U5H2z.gif

Once Hilda has dealt with the minions, Eulalia will land again, and this time with despair as she will cause feather storms to swoop around the amphitheatre. This is when the battle culminates – the feather storms will continually fire sharp blades as Hilda cautiously counters Eulalia's onslaught in close combat.

In the end, only the strongest will survive. 

https://i.imgur.com/CfGZniJ.jpg

We hope you enjoy this preview, and we can’t wait to share more about the world of Asterigos with you.
